About
THE
ARTIST

Klazik is a certified award-winning wordsmith from Cleveland, Ohio, currently residing in Des Moines, Iowa. A multifaceted artist and motivational speaker with over 20 years in the music industry, Klazik performs across the country with a focus on non-destructive hip hop through his brand Ill Team Six.

His music has captured the attention of A&Rs and executives from major labels and brands. Whether on stage at SXSW or headlining the Wisconsin Dells Music Summit, Klazik delivers raw artistry with purpose.
